'''Orla Defra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Defra lived in the platform [[City/Legends|city]] [[Soboll]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and worked as a [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] technician as part of a [[Thaereian military]] research team. She was an informer for the [[Cularin Militia]] and she was able to provide them with technical readouts about Soboll and Thaereian research. After the Thaereian military withdrew all their forces to Soboll, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] of the Militia sent the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to find out from Defra the location of the Thaereian commander, [[Kurth San]]. However, before they could meet with her, Defra was arrested by the Thaereians.
